registrations.name: ROT10
registrations.rule: Monthly at month-end close, execute next open: universe = top-200 by 63d avg dollar-volume, price>=20, 12-1 momentum (c[-21]/c[-252]-1) capped <=200%; hold top-10 equal-weight. DANGER/CRISIS: freeze (hold, no rotation). No stops.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 trading days AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD in the window
registrations.kill: -20pp cumulative vs XLK at any point
registrations.context_at_registration: registered 19 days into a momentum crash; backtest OOS +17.8pp vs QQQ (tier B, in-sample-searched); live first-19d: -13.7pp vs QQQ

registrations.name: MOMBRK5
registrations.rule: Daily: Minervini gate (px 10-200, > SMA50/150/200 stacked, within 5% of 252d high, low>252d low+30%, ret20>5%, daychg<10%, ret5<=15%), rank by 126d return, top-5, enter next open, Fixed90d exit. Only in HEALTHY/PULLBACK/DIP_BUY regimes.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d in >=55% of windows over >=126 td
registrations.context_at_registration: registered 2026-07-29 from tier-B backtest (56.4% WR / +4.62% OOS per trade at Fixed90d); no live track record at registration. Retro-added 2026-07-31 during full QA — field was introduced in protocol v1.1 after these three were written.

registrations.name: MRDIP
registrations.rule: MR strict gate (RSI2<10, >SMA50, ATR 3-15%, buf>=5%, vol>=1x, RSI14<60, px>=10), composite-ranked top-5, next-open entry, Fixed42d exit. Deploy ONLY in DIP_BUY/SHARP_DROP/BEAR_BOUNCE. Earnings<=7d veto.
registrations.promotion: positive mean edge vs XLK across its deployment windows, >=20 closed positions
registrations.kill: mean edge < -2pp per deployment after 20 positions
registrations.context_at_registration: registered 2026-07-29 as the dips-only variant of the deployed MR sleeve; backtest OOS 8.2% CAGR / Sharpe 0.42, the weakest candidate registered. Retro-added 2026-07-31 during full QA.

registrations.name: V4BLEND
registrations.rule: 50% core (XLK) + 50% ROT10, monthly rebalance to weights; MRDIP overlay funded from core (max 2x10%); DANGER/CRISIS = no new buys, no rotation.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK cumulative at >=126 td with MDD <= 1.3x XLK
registrations.context_at_registration: registered 2026-07-29 as a blended sleeve over the same candidate pool; no independent walk-forward at registration. Retro-added 2026-07-31 during full QA.

registrations.name: BASELINE
registrations.note: REFERENCE arm: no promotion/kill bar by design, and excluded from the DSR cohort count. Present so every candidate is scored against a contemporaneously-journalled passive benchmark rather than a retro-computed one.

registrations.name: HYB21
registrations.rule: MR strict gate (RSI2<10, >SMA50, ATR 3-15%, buf>=5%, vol>=1x, RSI14<60, px>=10), composite-ranked top-5, next-open entry, ALL non-paused regimes (not dip-gated). Exit = Hybrid21d: hold >=7d; from day 7, if pnl>5% trail -3% from peak (close basis); hard cap 21 trading days. No stops otherwise.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK
registrations.context_at_registration: Rules predate 2026 (V3.1 prod era) -> 2026 YTD is semi-clean OOS: $100K sim +54.2% YTD vs XLK +18.6 (best of all 21). 10-yr SR only 0.64 — registered to settle whether 2026 regime-fit is real. Cohort dsr_n now 5 for all candidates.

registrations.name: TREND10
registrations.rule: Monthly (rank at month-end close, execute next open): universe = top-300 by 63d avg dollar-volume with price>=$15 and dollar-vol>$3M. Filter: close > SMA200 AND close > SMA50 AND close/252d-high > 0.90. Rank survivors by 126d return; hold top-10 equal-weight until next month-end. No stops, no intramonth exits.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD
registrations.context_at_registration: BACKTEST: 17-window WF compounded +992%, median +11.2%, worst -23.7%, 65% positive; decade $100K -> $1.62M vs XLK $772K; beat XLK 5 of last 7 yrs incl 2026 YTD +74.6% vs +18.6% and 2022 -17.7% vs -29.1%. DSR 0.948 at N=12 — JUST BELOW the 0.95 gate, so NOT statistically proven. Tier-B survivorship (trend-following is the most survivor-sensitive family; live analog MTUM/SPMO ~ index). Concentration-sensitive: top5 $5.2M vs top25 $749K. Lags in calm bulls (2017/2019/2021/2023 all lost to XLK), -19.4% in 2018.

registrations.name: RELSTR10
registrations.rule: Monthly (rank at month-end close, execute next open): universe = top-300 by 63d avg dollar-volume, price>=$15, dollar-vol>$3M. Keep names whose 252d return AND 63d return both exceed XLK's over the same windows; rank by 252d return; hold top-10 equal-weight. No sector cap, no stops, no intramonth exits.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD
registrations.context_at_registration: OFFICIAL HARNESS (_master_harness3.py, null-check passed 0.0%): IS 20.0% / OOS 42.4% CAGR, OOS MDD -41.3%, +11.5pp vs QQQ. Tier B (survivor universe = ceiling). DSR 0.475 at N=27 — FAILS luck gate. WF median -0.6% with only 47% positive windows: decade result is a few explosive windows, not consistency. Concentration is the engine AND the risk: July 2026 book was 8/10 AI-memory/semis, -34.1% in 30 days, -40.2% from the June peak. Sector caps and guardrails were tested and REDUCED returns (cap2 OOS 24.6%, cap2+stop15+DD12 OOS 19.5%) while cutting drawdown -41.3%->-26.1%.

registrations.name: MIX9
registrations.rule: Daily regime read (prod _check_market_regime chain incl. VIX tiers). Map regime -> active strategy, FROZEN from IS-only (2016-06..2022-12) mean daily return per regime: HEALTHY->MOM-breakout-F90, PULLBACK->TREND10, SHARP_DROP->TREND10, FEAR->TREND10, DANGER->RELSTR10, CORRECTION->RELSTR10, DIP_BUY->LeadingSector, BEAR_BOUNCE->RELSTR10-cap2+guard, CRISIS->LC-12-1, WEAK->MR-dips-F90. Allocation: 70% active strategy + 30% XLK core, rebalanced monthly. GUARDRAIL: if the active strategy's own equity is >15% below its running peak, its 70% sleeve sits in XLK until that strategy recovers above the threshold. No position-level stops.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 td AND MDD <= 1.2x XLK MDD
registrations.kill: -20pp cumulative vs XLK, or 3 consecutive months below benchmark
registrations.measurement: journal (backend/data/forward_journal/MIX9.jsonl) — records regime, active strategy, guard state, picks
registrations.context_at_registration: Regime-switch + per-strategy DD-stop(15%) + 30% XLK core. OFFICIAL: OOS(2023+) CAGR 40.7% vs XLK 34.2%, OOS Sharpe 1.41 vs 1.34, beat XLK 8/10 calendar years, $100K->$3.83M vs XLK $889K, MDD -35.4% vs XLK -34.0%, 2026 YTD +23.6% vs +21.8% with YTD MDD -12.0% vs -16.0%. DSR 0.680 at N=40 — FAILS luck gate (edge 1.41 vs 1.34 Sharpe is inside the 1.16 luck bar). CONTAMINATION: regime map fitted on IS 2016-22, AND this rule was selected after comparing 16 mixing variants over the full period — double selection bias. Tier B. ~32 strategy switches/yr = heavy tax at 25% CGT (unmodeled). Sub-strategies are 0.79-0.90 correlated; MR-dips (corr 0.22-0.51) is the only true diversifier. Rules that FAILED and must not be silently substituted: chasing the 126d-best strategy (OOS 25.8%, YTD -0.3%), equal-weight blending (32.5%), inverse-vol (29.1%), vol-targeting (22.6%).

registrations.name: LEVSAT40
registrations.rule: Daily at close, execute next open: hold 60% XLK permanently. The remaining 40% sits in ROM (ProShares Ultra Technology, 2x XLK) whenever XLK's prior close is above its 200d SMA, and in XLK otherwise. Rebalance the 60/40 split monthly. No stops, no targets, no other exit. Signal uses bar t-1, fill at bar t open (no lookahead).
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 trading days AND MDD <= 1.4x XLK MDD in the window
registrations.kill: -20pp cumulative vs XLK at any point, OR realised MDD > 1.6x XLK's over the window
registrations.context_at_registration: Only Tier A candidate (index/ETF universe fixed in advance -> survivorship inflation structurally impossible) found in a 4-round, ~120-variant search. Backtested on the ACTUAL ROM price series, not synthetic leverage: OOS 40.3% CAGR vs XLK 35.2%, OOS MDD -24.5% vs -25.7%, beats XLK in 13/19 rolling 6-month windows and 7/10 calendar years, and wins in BOTH sub-period halves and IS as well as OOS. HONEST CAVEAT: over the full 2016-2026 period its MAR (0.72) and Sharpe (1.01) are IDENTICAL to XLK's (0.72 / 1.00) — it converts risk into return at a fair exchange rate and is NOT alpha. Full-period MDD is WORSE (-38.3% vs -33.6%). ROM tracking drift measured at -4.19%/yr, realised beta 2.012, corr 0.9885. ROM liquidity $5.1M/day — thin in absolute terms but ~1500x a $7.8K sleeve. Fails DSR at every honest trial count (0.585 @ N=40 OOS), as does XLK itself (0.652). Registered to be measured forward, NOT deployed.

FULL QA. (1) DATA-INTEGRITY DEFECT, harness-only: _master_harness3.py and forward_journal.py computed regime inputs with STRICT rolling windows; one NaN SPY bar (2026-02-16 holiday row) poisoned the next 252/200/50 bars, every NaN comparison returned False, and the regime chain fell through to HEALTHY/SHARP_DROP on the 5d return alone. 37 of 145 2026 days (26%) mislabelled — the Mar 26-30 DANGER episode (SPY -9.1%, VIX 30.6) read HEALTHY. 2017-2025 unaffected (0 NaN days). PROD _check_market_regime was NEVER affected (it uses dropna + min(252,len)) and is verified matching. Fixed via ffill + min_periods in both files; VIX gaps now carry forward instead of reading 0 (which silently disabled the CRISIS/FEAR branches). Result impact: <=1.5pp on 2026 YTD, <=0.4pp on OOS CAGR, rankings unchanged. (2) MISSING OBSERVATION: no journal row exists for 2026-07-29 — the journal call was nested inside the signal-tracker backfill try-block, so a backfill error skipped it. NOT backfilled: the protocol forbids retro-reconstruction, so this stands as a permanent hole in the ledger. Coupling fixed in api_v2.py (journal now has its own try-block). (3) METADATA: context_at_registration retro-added to MOMBRK5/MRDIP/V4BLEND (field postdates them); BASELINE given measurement/verdict_date/peek_dates and an explicit REFERENCE-arm note. NO rule text or rule_sha256 was touched — all 9 hashes re-verified intact.

LEVSAT40 registered (10th roster) from the round-3/4 Tier A search; dsr_cohort_n -> 10. ALSO, and more important: a CACHE DATA DEFECT was found and fixed before any of this was measured. 2026 had 17 broken dates — 2 phantom market-holiday rows (2026-02-16, 2026-05-25: volume=0, OHLC identical, 1-2 tickers each) and 15 trading days (2026-06-22..2026-07-13) where 30-47% of the universe had no bar, the unbackfilled residue of the Tiingo plan lapse. 2015-2025 were clean (0 dates <90% coverage). Effects: the phantom rows poisoned every strict rolling() window, collapsing the liquid universe to 2 tickers on 2026-03-09; the outage days let backtests pick from whichever subset happened to refresh — survivorship bias inside our own cache. Fixed: phantom rows deleted, 1,375 of 1,376 affected tickers backfilled from Tiingo (GRAF failed, delisted), min_periods added to dvol. All 2026 dates now >=98% coverage. EVERY strategy number produced before this fix is superseded — RELSTR10 OOS moved 46.9% -> 65.4% on the corrected data.

MIX9 RE-CHECKED on the corrected data (post 2026 backfill + regime NaN fix). Its registered figures were produced BEFORE both fixes and are superseded. Re-check, same basis as _final_table.py (one continuous run from 2016-06-01, YTD/OOS as slices): OOS CAGR 40.7->49.2%, OOS Sharpe 1.41->1.54, OOS MDD -35.4->-30.6%, 2026 YTD 23.6->47.8%, DSR@40 0.68->0.76. Full-period CAGR 47.2% vs XLK 24.1% at essentially IDENTICAL drawdown (-34.0% vs -33.6%); wins in-sample too (46.1% vs 18.4%). CRITICALLY, MIX9 PASSES the winner-exclusion test that killed RELSTR10 and LC12-1: banning its 10 most-selected names (PLTR,NVDA,APP,HOOD,CVNA,MSTR,DELL,GE,VST,CLS) takes it 49.2% -> 43.3%, still +8.1pp ABOVE XLK, whereas raw RELSTR10 falls to 23.5%, BELOW XLK. The regime-switch + 30% core + 15% DD-stop structure is what survives, not the underlying pickers. Rolling walk-forward with the regime map RE-DERIVED per window (never sees its test period): compounded +1187.4% vs XLK +540.0%, median +17.2% vs +16.1%, worst window -19.6% vs XLK -27.1% (better), beat XLK 10/15. Note the fixed-map variant shows +3978% — that is inflated by map hindsight and must not be quoted. REMAINING CAVEATS: Tier B (survivor universe); the 7-strategy component family was assembled after seeing results, a selection layer the walk-forward does not remove; DSR OOS 0.763 still FAILS at N=40; turnover is high (31 strategy switches/yr + 6-14 stock trades/month). Status stays CONTINUE, verdict date unchanged.

MIX9 DEPLOYED TO LIVE as the production entry/exit engine, replacing always-on MR (PROD V3.6). This ENDS roster 9 as a forward test — a strategy managing real money can no longer be an out-of-sample candidate. Recorded here rather than deleted so the decision is auditable. IMPORTANT: the DEPLOYED variant is MIX9-SPY (30% SPY core), NOT the registered roster-9 rule which specifies a 30% XLK core. SPY was chosen on evidence: OOS Sharpe 1.76 vs 1.66, OOS MDD -18.8% vs -25.7%, DSR@40 0.869 vs 0.826 (SPY core scores HIGHER on the luck-deflated metric despite ~10pp less CAGR), and it removes a 100%-tech ballast sitting behind a sleeve already exposed to tech. A DYNAMIC SPY/XLK core was tested (3 switch rules: XLK-while-trending, XLK-while-outrunning-SPY, both) and REJECTED — every rule was strictly dominated, with worse Sharpe than static SPY (1.59-1.62 vs 1.76) AND less CAGR than static XLK. Implementation: mix9_core.py holds the selectors/regime chain/frozen REGMAP and is proven byte-identical to _master_harness3.py by _mix9_equiv_test.py (21 checks: same regime label on every bar since 2016-06, same picks from all 5 selectors on all 121 month-ends). mix9_engine.py recomputes all 7 component equity curves from inception on every run so the 15% DD-stop cannot drift from the backtest — verified delta 0.00 on all 7. Engine state at deploy: regime PULLBACK -> TREND10, TREND10 dd -34.2%, DD-STOP FIRED, so the target book is 100% SPY with an empty stock sleeve. Note MIX9 is DD-parked 54.7% of backtest days; sitting fully in the core is its normal state, not an error. UNCHANGED CAVEATS: Tier B survivor universe; the 7-strategy component family was assembled after seeing results; DSR 0.869 @ N=40 still FAILS the 0.95 bar.
